reference_data: Full historical physical 24 states at every original k with original f and n_out; same authenticated file bytes for corresponding workers

rhs_30_extra_columns.construction: Append six ComplexF64 MersenneTwister Gaussian columns to original Gamma X; operator-only, not physical occupations

micro_operations: FR mul! at original first Gamma block
component lift mul! at same fixed n_out common block
full_k_operations: orbital_density with original order/capacity and streaming
nonlocal expectation plus independent projected contraction
seven-term energy_snapshot with all independent consistency checks
static_pipeline: One source loader/context construction and deep authentication, H[n_out], all nine Gamma micro actions, full-k orbital density, nonlocal/direct-projector and seven-term energy checks, final deep boundary, scoped lifetime close. Reference has no lifecycle close API: retain and measure its actual global registrations until worker ends; do not silently clear its audit globals. Constructor first call is separately recorded.

sampling.retain: All samples/median/min/max for time, Julia allocation bytes, GC, compilation fields when available; checksum consumed. No cherry-picking
sampling.cold_initialization: Record once separately, do not include in warmed performance ratio
sampling.gc: Normal enabled GC, no forced collections in measured numerical loops; optional explicit full GC only for separately labeled between-session reachability tests

measurement_scope.allocated_bytes: @timed cumulative Julia allocation, not live memory or RSS
measurement_scope.unique_live: One roots union incl old registry, native context/basis/operator/data/workspace/state references; Base.summarysize with alias-aware underlying storage inventory and views/parent relationships, no sum of individual summarysize
measurement_scope.rss: Same frozen process-group/descendant sampler and interval0.1s, same host/threads, native library/JIT included; sampled not continuous bound

endpoint.old_thresholds_and_closure: All unchanged; no inferred new physical convergence

kernel_boundaries: density/potential/G/P/D changes and every custom callback return
kernel_checks_each_call: finite input and alpha/beta; beta0 does not read Y

rhs_shapes.1: single vector from original Gamma column1
rhs_shapes.30: same24 plus six seeded operator-only columns
